Record map operations, transaction lookup, publish, and verification logic.

# Purpose
This C file implements the record layer for `funk`. It defines the concrete record pool `fd_funk_rec_pool` and the record hash map `fd_funk_rec_map` by using the generic pool and chained-map templates. The file also provides the main record operations: lookup by transaction and key, global lookup across transaction ancestry, record prepare, record publish, and record verification. These functions manage the link between a record and the transaction that owns it, and they enforce state checks for active and frozen transactions.

The code also handles record insertion into the transaction list and into the record map. When atomic support is enabled, [`fd_funk_rec_push_tail`](<#fd_funk_rec_push_tail>) uses compare-and-swap operations to append records to a transaction list in a way that supports concurrent publish activity. The [`fd_funk_rec_verify`](<#fd_funk_rec_verify>) function walks the record map, transaction lists, and pool to check internal consistency, list links, and membership rules.
